runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 13.9.2026 03:38 public-web sweep across 12 actually searched source families. No new unique promotion-grade job passed ranking, language, skill and locality gates; jobs-data.json therefore stays fail-closed at 52 LIVE items. LinkedIn surfaced multiple SupportYourApp remote roles but they require C1/fluent English, additional German/Swedish, or T3/infrastructure skills. NATEK Salesforce CRM Support Manager is remote with only quarterly Bratislava/Prague travel, but is senior Salesforce operational ownership and therefore outside target scope. Worki surfaced current Bratislava/Devínska Nová Ves VZV/warehouse roles, but they are physical three-shift warehouse work and rank below current inventory. StartupJobs surfaced MAGU Customer Care in Prague and a remote Marketing & Product Specialist, but indexed evidence did not establish a Slovakia-executable target-role promotion. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts with direct links.

developmentChanges.title: Timezone and shift burden score
developmentChanges.reason: For remote roles, explicitly score working-hour alignment with Slovakia and penalize night/APAC/US shifts even when location eligibility is remote-ok. This prevents technically remote jobs from ranking highly when their schedule is impractical.

developmentChanges.title: Remote travel-frequency ledger
developmentChanges.reason: Store mandatory travel frequency, destinations, duration and whether travel cost/time is compensated. A role can remain remote-ok when travel is genuinely occasional, while ranking reflects the real burden and avoids treating quarterly travel the same as weekly hybrid attendance.
